scenes.setting: Grace at the Hall table interrupted twice by the fog: 'Card of Blasphemy' and a 3000-pound thank-you from the 'adorer'; over breakfast Count Hall relays the twelfth murder and the comic eyewitness who fled screaming — Audrey wishes that poor man sweet dreams
scenes.text_anchor: “That was a Card of Blasphemy made by Roselle.”

scenes.setting: The looted study: Archbishop Horamick Haydn clears the aristocratic visitors, reads two opposed intruders in the residue — one perhaps above his own Sequence — and grasps the truth: 'We've been tricked by Roselle for more than 150 years…'
scenes.text_anchor: “We've been tricked by Roselle for more than 150 years…”

scenes.setting: Aftermath housekeeping: the Dark Emperor card and Master Key stored above the fog, the escape reviewed clue by clue — and a fresh letter from Isengard Stanton waits in the mailbox
scenes.text_anchor: The letter was from Isengard Stanton.
